note: Quests the game wants completed before it offers a quest that neither the sheet's previous quests nor its accept conditions (QuestAcceptAdditionCondition) record, mostly a main scenario milestone the quest's own text asks for. The catalog adds them to the quest's prerequisites as an "all" list. Every entry names at least two sources that each name every required id: "gameText" (the quest text row in gameTextKey; the text is never committed), "questionable" (a hand-added link in docs/data/questionable-prerequisites.json) and "wiki" (the Console Games Wiki infobox, as docs/data/quest-verification.csv records it). Keys are Quest sheet row ids, sorted ascending.
